objective: Extend CAGR and matched-market drawdown research toward a century. Desired counts remain aspirations, not quotas. Full century accounts hold RF cash through signal warmup; active-only primary comparisons are93 years and later50 years. Earlier every-complete-calendar-year10% floor remains a diagnostic.
counting: Same200 configured policies in20 related families, adapted to30 complete industry portfolios; not200 new inventions. Four controls;4 windows x3 costs x2 lags=4896 accounts. Changes of universe and warmup are explicitly separate from the49-industry study.

account.timing: For month t use data through t-lag. Primary lag2 leaves one whole month gap. Lag1 is idealized latest-month sensitivity. Costed rebalance before earning montht index/RF return; no real fill-price proof. Feature rows carry synthetic as_of=information month-end; not original publication time.
account.risk_free_cash: Residual cash earns realized current-month RF exceptCZERO. No forward RF enters allocation signals. Cash transactions have no fees.
account.rebalance: Monthly all candidates and CEQ (equal30industryweights); CMKT buy-and-hold after initial98% allocation; CRF andCZERO holdcash. Fees charged on absolute risky dollars changed; NAV_after+rate*turnover=NAV_before. Terminal risky liquidation charged at finalmonthend.
account.drawdown: Opening pre/post-cost and month-end/terminal marks only; intra-month/intraday loss unknown.

warmup.mechanism: All candidate identities holdRFcash with no risky trades through1932-12; no account reset atactivation. Actual cash-accrual NAV and account peak remainCPPI state. FixedCPPI floor remainsfraction ofinitial1000; ratchet useslaggedfundedaccountpeak. Controls are active from first accountmonth. Freshtraining/evaluation/full accounts each start1000.
warmup.interpretation: Centurystart is100years funded-account history but93.5years active rule history. Cashwarmup mechanically avoids1929-1932 risky exposure; not demonstrated predictive crash avoidance.

account.annual_metrics: Use only complete12-month calendar years for annualfloor, losingyear, minimumannualreturn and thresholdcounts. Century1926Jul-Dec and2026Jan-Jun retained separately aspartial_calendar_returns and included in whole-accountCAGR/DD. No partialyear annualization.

selection.before_evaluation: Compute alltrainingcases first. Atprimarycost/lag choose up to5candidates each: stable(positiveCAGR,smallerDDthanCMKT; rankleastDDthenhigherCAGRthenID),growth10(CAGR>=.10; rankCAGRthenID),growth25(CAGR>=.25; same). Savechoices before evaluation/full. Emptygroupsstayempty.
selection.robust_candidate_screen: PositiveCAGR in full andevaluation for ALL6cost/lagcases. Stable additionallyhas strictlysmaller absoluteDDthan matchedCMKT inall12comparisons. >=10and>=25 thresholdcounts shown forprimaryfullANDprimaryevaluation; scenario sensitivity separate. All are retrospective candidates, no broker qualification. Primaryfull means1933-2025; evaluation1976-2025. Centuryaccount counts are separate diagnostics and cannot qualify a primaryscreen. Reconstructed and previously explored history is not an untouched holdout.

regimes.causal_labels: At t-lag classify trailing12market excess compoundreturn positive/negative, and trailing12market samplevol above/below expandingmedian of trailing12vol availablethroughcutoff (starting1926-07). Fourstates, no tuning.
regimes.interpretation: Posthoc performance slices and exposure/contribution explanation are associations/mechanics, not proofnews causedreturns or a forecast.
regimes.diagnostic_partial_tail: The2023-2032 label contains actual2023-2025 observations only; CAGR uses12/observedmonths. Report actualdates/monthcount, never describe it as a completeddecade.

multiple_testing.evaluation: 200candidate primarycost/lag monthlynetreturns minusmatchedCMKT; centered stationary-block bootstrap, mean block6months,2000replicates,seed20261020; sharedindices acrosscandidates; compare observedmean to bootstrapmaximum acrossall200; adjustedp=(1+exceedances)/2001. Resamplingdiagnostic notfutureprofitprobability, doesnotaccountallpriorprojecttrials ormodelmisspecification.

immutability: No ruleorparameterchanges after newperformance; softwarebugfixes requireerrata preservingfailedruns. No leverageincrease or hindsightstockselection to fillquotas.

inheritance.policy_parameters: Exact same200 policy dictionaries; no rule, lookback, top_k, target_vol, floor or multiplier retuning
new_engine_differences: Centurystart candidates holdRFcash until1933-01 while controls start1926-07

statistical_scope: One new200-policy familywise diagnostic over primary1976-2025 evaluation. Universe, date windows,priorstudyresults and broader economic history are already known. It is retrospective chronological validation, not proof of futureprofit or virginholdout. No pooling of old andnew winners to fillcounts.
